# Manual Hindi semantic review — batch 098

Date: 2026-10-14  
Scope: English sense indices 2425–2449, 25 senses

I reread every English definition and source example and checked the Hindi gloss and example individually. The function-word translations were generally accurate. I corrected five examples whose contexts had drifted from the English source: `beyond`, `anybody`, `till`, `beside`, and `beneath`.

Changed: 5 Hindi example/gloss pairs; 25 senses reviewed.

Progress: 2,450/8,837 Hindi word senses independently checked (27.72%); 6,387 remain.

This batch does not complete the overall semantic review; more batches remain.
